cases.input: Build a patent landscape for a diagnostic biomarker assay field using keywords, CPC/IPC classes, assignees and citation chains, and document family, jurisdiction, status and independent-claim themes as of today.
requiredBehaviors: document a reproducible iterative search strategy rather than treating one keyword query as complete
deduplicate publications into families while preserving materially distinct claim-scope branches
attach freshness and source evidence to decision-relevant legal-status statements
forbiddenBehaviors: equate family-level relevance with one uniform claim scope
present the landscape as a patentability or FTO opinion
skillAnchors: Ein einzelner Keyword Search darf nicht als vollständige Landschaft ausgegeben werden
Patentfamilie und Claim Scope dürfen nicht gleichgesetzt werden

cases.input: A core family has parallel US continuations and EP divisionals sharing priority but containing materially different independent claims and partially different status histories.
requiredBehaviors: preserve common priority while representing distinct continuation and divisional claim-scope branches separately
report jurisdiction-specific status and uncertainty instead of one global family status
forbiddenBehaviors: collapse divergent continuation or divisional claims into a single generic family claim theme
infer current enforceability from shared priority alone

cases.input: A commercial patent aggregator labels a relevant family active, but an official register appears inconsistent and some target-jurisdiction members cannot be verified.
requiredBehaviors: keep the aggregator useful for discovery but verify material status against official sources where accessible
mark unresolved status and jurisdiction coverage as explicit uncertainty or search gaps
forbiddenBehaviors: treat the aggregator active label as final legal status
hide missing official evidence behind a completeness claim
skillAnchors: Ein Aggregatorstatus allein ist keine abschließende Statusfeststellung
